headline: Teams Calling Titans On Tony Pollard, Calvin Ridley; Latest On Tennessee Trade Outlook
summary: The Titans cashed in their top trade chip Thursday, sending Jeffery Simmons to the Bears for a package headlined by two first-round picks. headline: Ravens QB Jackson to return for Bills clash, calls ankle pain 'bearable'
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will return to play Sunday at Buffalo, saying the pain in his injured left ankle is "bearable."

headline: Defensive tweaks on deck for the Cowboys
summary: Todd Archer details Dallas Cowboys DC Christian Parker's adjustments following a league-high number of opening-possession touchdowns allowed.

headline: Dave Canales says defensive coaching changes are about the players feeling confident
summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales fired defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero and defensive passing game coordinator Jonathan Cooley less than 12 hours after Thursday night's loss to the Packers, and Canales said on Friday afternoon that he wants his players to be confident in their defense.
